name: sme-full-tile-staggered-unroll4
hypothesis: Start from existing-sme, which has the highest measured median. Panel packing and batching two steps of loads did not improve that median. Keep its full transpose layout, but give complete output tiles an all-active, four-step loop that interleaves next-step loads with current-step outer products. This tests whether spreading loads across arithmetic reduces load stalls and loop overhead. Tail tiles retain predicated computation. This candidate is untested; the supplied timing spread does not establish a stable gain or achievement of the target.
